newsitem.title: ITALY: New Alitalia/Continental flight frm Rome to New York.
newsitem.headline: New Alitalia/Continental flight frm Rome to New York.

text.p: Italian flag carrier Alitalia and Continental Airlines said in a statement a second code-shared daily McDonnell Douglas DC-10 flight will operate from June 2 between Rome-Fiumicino and New York-Newark airports.
The code sharing operation on the route started in June 1994 and the new flight will provide an additional 15 tonnes of cargo capacity.
Alitalia Cargo will handle cargo sales for the morning flight, while International Tourist Representative, the general sales agent for Continental cargo from June 1 --will handle the afternoon sales.
A press conference will be held on June 2 at Fiumicino airport with Alitalia and Continental Airlines. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
